name: Beetling
description: Flat rules hammered to a sheen that sits in one soft pool.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 9%, transparent 9% 18%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 50% 40%, #000 0 20%, transparent 92%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 9%, transparent 9% 18%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 50% 40%, #000 0 20%, transparent 92%); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
